ideas-none: This product has no ad ideas yet.
ideas-preparing: The ad ideas are still being prepared. They appear here when they are ready.
ideas-intro: Keep the ones you want to use. You can leave the rest.
ideas-making: {{count}} more ads are being made. They appear here when they are ready.
ideas-making_one: {{count}} more ad is being made. It appears here when it is ready.
ideas-panel-jump: See what the AI read about the product, and which facts are still to check.
ideas-no-photo-hint: Some ads were made without a product photo. Add a product photo so the product in them looks more like the real thing.
ideas-competitors-overlap: Competitors in your scan say this too
ideas-competitors-unclaimed: No competitor in your scan says this yet
ideas-earlier-description: Their claim was deleted or redrafted, so these images can't be downloaded. You can stop keeping them.
ideas-ad-telling-unknown: Way of telling: no longer in the ideas
ideas-ad-retry-unavailable: Trying again from here isn't available yet.
ideas-ad-retry-after-batch: The first batch is still making or checking its other images; you can retry here once it is done.
ideas-ad-retry-after-stop: The first batch stopped. Sort out why on its progress page first; then you can retry here.
ideas-keep-ad-gone: This ad is no longer here. Refresh the page.
ideas-keep-uncertain: Couldn't confirm whether that went through. Refresh the page to check.
ideas-kept-none-hint: Keep the ads you want to use, then check and download them.
ideas-kept-hint: They're still drafts. Check the facts and photos once before downloading.
ideas-panel-title: What the AI read about the product
ideas-panel-no-facts: The AI hasn't found any facts yet.
ideas-panel-check-note: Before downloading, you check once the facts your kept ads use.
start-title: Paste a product link and see what its ads could look like
start-intro: We read the product, think of claims worth trying and make the first ads. After you start, there is nothing else to click.
start-cost-note: That is the most it can cost. It is paid to the AI provider through your own API key, and only what is used is charged.
start-key-hint: For now the first ads need an OpenAI key. We ask OpenAI whether it works before saving it, then keep it encrypted for this workspace. You can change it in Settings later. Note: OpenAI requires an organization to be verified before it can use its image models; a key from an unverified organization saves fine but is refused when making images.
start-key-then-start: Once it is saved, the button shows the most it can cost; click it again to start.
start-key-save-and-start: Save key and start · up to {{cost}}
start-key-saved: Key saved. OpenAI confirmed that it works.
start-key-rejected: OpenAI did not accept this key, so it was not saved. Check the key and that its account has credit.
start-key-rejected-invalid: OpenAI says this key is not valid, so it was not saved. Check that you copied all of it.
start-key-rejected-access: OpenAI did not let this key read the list of models, so it was not saved. A restricted key needs permission to read models.
start-key-rejected-quota: This key's OpenAI account has no credit left or has reached its spending limit, so the key was not saved.
start-key-check-unavailable: We couldn't reach OpenAI to check the key, so it was not saved. Try again in a moment.
start-key-check-unsupported: This key can't be checked before saving, so it was not saved. Paste an OpenAI key.
start-key-exists: This workspace already has an OpenAI key that isn't switched on. Switch it on or replace it in Settings.
start-key-unresolved: We couldn't confirm whether the key was saved. Refresh the page to check.
start-key-not-enabled: The key was saved but couldn't be switched on for making ads. Switch it on in Settings.
start-key-ask-owner: Ask the workspace Owner to add an OpenAI API key first. Only the Owner can add keys.
start-unavailable: You can't start right now. Try again later, or ask the workspace Owner.
start-unavailable-price: The cost of making ads isn't set up on this site yet, so you can't start. Contact the administrator.
start-unavailable-budget: This would go over the workspace's spending limit. The Owner can raise it in Settings.
start-unavailable-not-set-up: Making ads isn't fully set up on this site yet, so you can't start. Contact the administrator.
start-quote-failed: We couldn't work out the cost, so you can't start yet.
start-problem-cost-changed: The cost changed. Check the new maximum on the button, then start.
start-problem-unavailable: You can't start right now. The page now says why.
start-problem-unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm whether it started. Click again; it won't start twice.
start-problem-upload: An image couldn't be uploaded. Remove it or try again.
start-examples-title: Example: 3 claims and 6 ads for Acme Charge
start-examples-note: These are made-up examples, not your product. Your ads are made from what we read about your product.
start-example-claim-1: Plug in at night and forget about it
reading-not-found: This start can't be found here. It may belong to another workspace.
reading-intro: You can close this page; it keeps going. Come back any time to see how far it got.
reading-slow: This is taking longer than usual. It is still reading and nothing failed: you can close this page and come back to see the progress.
reading-found-waiting: Facts about the product appear here as soon as they are read.
reading-guesses-note: Nobody has checked these; they are never written into ads as facts.
reading-photos: Product photos the ads may use
reading-photos-note: Unchecked photos may be used for drafts; you check them before downloading.
reading-facts-unchecked: None of these is checked yet. That doesn't hold anything up; you check them once before downloading.
reading-see-ads: See the ads made so far
stop-kept: Everything done so far is kept.
stop-unresolved: We couldn't confirm whether it continued. Click again; it won't run twice.
stop-cannot-continue: This can't continue right now. Refresh the page later, or ask the workspace Owner.
stop-several_models-body: Choose the one to make ads for.
stop-page_unreadable-body: The page couldn't be opened, or it isn't a product page. Paste the product's description or a screenshot of the page, and start again.
stop-reading_failed-title: We couldn't make a product from what we read
stop-reading_failed-body: Paste the product's description or screenshots of it, and start again.
stop-too_few_claims-title: Not enough to go on for two claims
stop-too_few_claims-body: What we read can't carry at least two claims. Add more about the product: what it does, who it is for, what makes it different. No ads were made, so nothing was spent on images.
stop-too_few_claims-placeholder: For example: what it does, who it's for, what sets it apart
stop-over_budget-title: The next step would go over your maximum
stop-over_budget-body: You confirmed up to {{cost}}. Continuing raises that.
stop-ideas_refused-title: The claims didn't pass our checks twice
stop-ideas_refused-body: Both drafts broke our rules, so we stopped instead of trying again on our own. You can have them drafted once more.
stop-step_failed-body: It may be a passing problem. Trying again repeats only this step.
stop-images-failed-body: Trying again makes only those again. The ads already made stay as they are.
stop-uncertain-title: We don't know yet whether a step went through
stop-uncertain-body: To avoid paying twice, it is never sent again on its own. An administrator has to check against the AI provider's records whether it went through; there is no place on the page to check it yourself yet, so ask your administrator. Once it has been checked, you can continue here.
stop-uncertain-images-body: To avoid paying twice, the image is never asked for again on its own. Choose Check it and say in the image record whether it was made (your OpenAI usage records can tell); then come back here to continue.
stop-uncertain-waiting: Waiting for that check. This page looks again every few seconds.
stop-why-budget: It would have gone over the workspace's spending limit. The Owner can raise it in Settings.
stop-why-key: The workspace's OpenAI key can't be used. The Owner can check it in Settings.
stop-why-image-key: OpenAI refused to make images with this key. Usually the key's OpenAI organization hasn't been verified yet (its image models need verification), or the key has no image permission. Sort it out in your OpenAI account, then try again.
stop-why-not-set-up: Making ads isn't fully set up on this site. Contact the administrator.
ideas-batch-running: The first ads are still being made.
ideas-batch-stopped: Making the first ads stopped and is waiting for you.
ideas-batch-retry-together: Trying again makes every ad that didn't come out again, not just one.
profile-earlier-title: This product was added before the new layout
profile-earlier-text: Its details are kept on its product card. View and change them there, as before.
profile-intro: This is what the AI read about the product. Ads only use the facts below, each with where it was read. Only facts you've checked can appear in ads you download.
profile-reading: The AI is still reading this product. What it reads will show up here.
profile-uncertain: No answer came back, so it's unclear whether this went through. Trying again repeats the same request; it won't happen twice.
profile-stale: Someone else just changed this product profile. Refresh to see the latest, then try again.
profile-source-missing: Those source words aren't in the product material. Check they match word for word, or paste the text that has them under “Add material”.
profile-claim-unsupported: For numbers, certifications and prices, the source words have to say the same thing.
profile-busy: The AI is working on this product right now. Try again when it's done.
profile-fact-gone: This fact isn't there any more. Refresh to see the latest.
profile-facts-intro: Each one says where it was read. Only checked facts can appear in ads you download.
profile-facts-none: The AI didn't find any facts. You can add one yourself.
profile-edit-warning: {{count}} ads use this fact. Once you change it, they need to be made again, and can't be downloaded until then.
profile-edit-warning_one: {{count}} ad uses this fact. Once you change it, that ad needs to be made again, and can't be downloaded until then.
profile-form-unchecked-note: Once saved, this fact is “not checked yet” again.
profile-form-new-note: A new fact starts as “not checked yet”. Once you check it, it can appear in ads you download.
profile-fact-add-hint: A new fact needs a source: the exact words from the product page, a manual or the packaging.
profile-fact-limit: A product can have up to {{limit}} facts. Delete one to add another.
profile-form-statement-hint: One clear sentence, such as “IP55 enclosure, can be installed outdoors”.
profile-form-quote-hint: The exact words from the product material, word for word.
profile-form-material-hint: If those words aren't in what the AI read, paste the text that has them here, such as a manual or the packaging. It's kept with this product's material.
profile-delete-ads: {{count}} ads use this fact. Once it's deleted, they need to be made again, and can't be downloaded until then.
profile-delete-ads_one: {{count}} ad uses this fact. Once it's deleted, that ad needs to be made again, and can't be downloaded until then.
profile-delete-claims: {{count}} claims are built on this fact directly. Once it's deleted, their ads stay “needs redoing” until you change or delete those claims on the ideas page (under “More” on each claim).
profile-delete-claims_one: {{count}} claim is built on this fact directly. Once it's deleted, its ads stay “needs redoing” until you change or delete that claim on the ideas page (under “More” on the claim).
profile-delete-undo: This can't be undone. To use the fact again, you'd add it again.
profile-guesses-intro: These are guesses. Nobody has checked them, and they're never written into ads as facts.
profile-guess-need: Why people need this kind of product
profile-unknowns-title: What the AI doesn't know yet
profile-answer-note: Once saved, this becomes a fact that's not checked yet, and leaves this list.
profile-photos-intro: The photos the AI found when it read the product, and the ones you added. Images are made with them so the product looks like the real thing. Checking a photo means you confirm it's a real photo of this product and that you have the right to use it in ads. An ad made with photos can be downloaded only once they're checked.
profile-photos-none: No product photo was found when the product was read, so its ads were made without one. Before downloading, you confirm the product in each image looks right.
profile-brand-intro: Logo, fonts, colors, text rules and what must never appear. Each save keeps a new version; images already made don't change.
ideas-batch-checking: Every ad is made. The checks are still running; each result appears on its ad as it finishes.
ideas-ad-origin-image_tool: Processed by AI (upscale, background or erase)
ideas-unchecked-hint: Some new images aren't checked yet. New images are checked only when you ask.
ideas-adding-claim: Thinking of another claim… It appears here when it's ready.
ideas-adding-expression: Thinking of another way of telling… It appears here when it's ready.
ideas-adding-refused: The last idea didn't come out right (for example, it repeated a way of telling the claim already has). Nothing changed; you can try again.
ideas-adding-failed: The last idea couldn't be drafted: {{reason}}
ideas-uncertain: Couldn't confirm whether that went through. Trying again won't do it twice.
ideas-refusal-checks-key: Checking needs your OpenAI key. Save it in Settings first.
ideas-refusal-claim_cites_removed_fact: This claim still uses a fact that was deleted, so a new image would need redoing too. Change the claim first and take that fact off.
ideas-refusal-ad_needs_redo: This ad needs redoing, so cropping or processing it won't make it downloadable. Redo it with a note instead.
ideas-refusal-first_batch_running: The first ads are still being made. You can add more once they're done.
ideas-refusal-ideas_prompt_changed: This image's instructions changed since the cost was worked out. Ask for the cost again.
ideas-refusal-ideas_changed: Its claim or copy changed after this image was made, so it can't be redone. Make one with what's there now instead.
ideas-refusal-ideas_drafts_already_prepa: These ads were already prepared with other image settings. Switch the image settings back to make them now.
ideas-refusal-external_creative_not_rege: Your own images can't be redone or processed by AI. You can crop or rotate them, or upload another one.
ideas-refusal-stale_marketing_revision: These ideas changed in the meantime. Look at them again and confirm once more.
ideas-refusal-checks_quote_changed: What checking costs has changed. The button now shows the new maximum; click it again to go ahead.
ideas-refusal-check_changed: A newer check came in for one of these ads. Look at its findings again, then confirm.
ideas-refusal-planner_unavailable: What drafting costs changed, or drafting isn't available right now. Look at the new maximum and try again.
ideas-refusal-preview_expired: The worked-out cost expired. Ask for the cost again.
ideas-refusal-stale_draft_revision: This image changed since the cost was worked out. Ask for the cost again.
ideas-reason-ideas_changed: It no longer matches its claim and copy as they are now.
ideas-reason-facts_changed: A fact it uses was changed after it was made.
ideas-reason-facts_removed: A fact it uses was deleted.
ideas-reason-photo_unavailable: A product photo it used was rejected or can't be used any more. Make it again: the new image won't use that photo.
ideas-reason-image_blocked: The image was stopped by its own check when it was made.
ideas-reason-facts_unverified: Some facts it uses aren't checked yet.
ideas-reason-photo_unverified: A product photo it used isn't checked yet. Once it's checked, it doesn't need redoing.
ideas-reason-appearance_unconfirmed: Made without a product photo: confirm the product looks right.
ideas-reason-image_check_in_progress: The image is still being checked as it's made.
ideas-reason-check_failed: Its check didn't finish. Check it again.
ideas-reason-check_uncertain: Its check result isn't known yet.
ideas-reason-findings_open: The check found things you haven't looked at yet.
ideas-reason-check_outdated: It was checked against facts that have changed since.
paid-note: Nothing is spent until you click. You're charged at most this amount.
paid-uncertain: Couldn't confirm whether that started. Clicking again won't make a second image.
paid-started: Started. The new image appears in the ad ideas when it's ready, as a draft that needs checking.
again-start: Make it again as it is
checks-unavailable-credential_required: Checking needs your OpenAI key. Save it in Settings first.
checks-unavailable-checks_in_progress: A check is still running. Its results appear on each ad when it finishes.
finding-gate-rendered_text_mismatch: The text in the image isn't the ad's copy
finding-gate-rendered_text_missing: Some text in the image couldn't be read, so it couldn't be compared with the copy
finding-gate-claim_evidence_missing: The image says something the facts don't back up
finding-gate-product_reference_missing: Please confirm the product looks right
finding-gate-supporting_facts_missing: No fact backs up what the image says
finding-gate-brand_logo_missing: The logo couldn't be checked: the original logo is no longer available
finding-gate-extra_text: The image has words besides the headline and body
finding-gate-extra_text_unsupported: Words in the image say something the facts don't back up
finding-check-file_valid: The image file opens and is this version
finding-check-product_fidelity: The product looks and is used as it really is
finding-check-facts_supported: What the image says is backed by the product's facts
finding-check-expression_realized: The way of telling shows in the image
finding-check-copy_consistent: The image and the copy agree
finding-check-language_correct: All text is in the ad's language and readable
finding-check-brand_style: Logo, colors and style follow the brand
finding-check-text_readable: All text is clear and not cut off
finding-text-headline: The headline in the image reads “{{rendered}}”; the copy says “{{expected}}”.
finding-text-body_copy: The body text in the image reads “{{rendered}}”; the copy says “{{expected}}”.
finding-unsupported: Said without a fact to back it:
finding-extra-text: Words besides the headline and body:
check-intro: Only what the {{count}} ads you kept use. What you check here doesn't need checking again.
check-intro_one: Only what the ad you kept uses. What you check here doesn't need checking again.
check-facts-intro: Read each one. Tick it if it's true of the product.
check-facts-none: Nothing to check: the facts these ads use are checked already.
check-facts-none-nothing-ready: No kept ad can be downloaded this time, so there are no facts to check. What each ad still needs is below, under “Can't be downloaded this time”.
check-facts-change-note: If you change a fact, the ads that use it need redoing.
check-looks-intro: These ads were made without a product photo. Look at each image and confirm the product looks like the real thing.
check-looks-none: No product photo or look to check.
check-look-confirm: The product in this image looks right
check-findings-intro: Look at each one. If it's fine as it is, say so; or redo the ad, or leave it out of this download.
check-findings-clear: {{count}} ads have nothing to look at.
check-findings-clear_one: 1 ad has nothing to look at.
check-redo-started: Redoing has started. To download the others now, leave this one out.
check-later-intro: These kept ads can't be downloaded yet. The others can.
check-waiting-check_needed: Not checked yet. Check it first.
check-waiting-checking: Still being checked. It moves up when the result is in.
check-waiting-check_uncertain: Its check result isn't known yet. Look again in a little while.
check-waiting-check_outdated: It was checked against facts that have changed. Redo it to download it.
check-waiting-photo: A product photo it used isn't checked yet, and it can't be checked here.
check-confirm-title: Once checked, these {{count}} ads are no longer drafts
check-confirm-title_one: Once checked, this ad is no longer a draft
check-confirm-none-hint: Every kept ad needs something first; see above.
check-confirm-hint: Each ad downloads as its own file.
check-done-note: Each ad is its own file, named with its ad code. If your browser asks, allow it to download several files.
edit-gone: This ad is no longer here. Go back to the ad ideas.
edit-copy-uploaded: This is your own image: its words are yours, and changing the copy doesn't affect it. To change the copy of this way of telling, open an image made for it.
edit-copy-preview-note: The words in an image don't change by themselves: once saved, make a new image and it will carry this copy.
edit-copy-redo: Once saved, the {{count}} images already made for this way of telling need making again with the new copy before they can be downloaded.
edit-copy-redo_one: Once saved, the image already made for this way of telling needs making again with the new copy before it can be downloaded.
edit-copy-free: Saving the copy is free. Only this ad's headline and body text change; the claim, the way of telling and its facts stay.
edit-copy-saved: Copy saved. Images made with the old copy need making again before they can be downloaded.
edit-copy-make-start: Make one with the new copy
edit-copy-make-confirm: Make one with the new copy · up to {{cost}}
copy-problem-uncertain: We didn't hear back. Try again; it won't be changed twice.
copy-problem-stale: These ideas just changed. Refresh and try again.
copy-problem-gone: This ad is no longer in the ideas. Refresh to see what's there now.
copy-problem-unsupported: These aren't in the facts this ad uses: {{claims}}. Change them, or add a source in the product profile first and have the claim use that fact.
copy-problem-unsupported-none: The copy says something the facts this ad uses don't. Change it, or add a source in the product profile first.
copy-problem-language: Write the headline and body text in the ads' language.
copy-problem-too-long: The headline and body text are too long to fit when the image is made. Cut about {{count}} characters.
copy-problem-too-long_one: The headline and body text are too long to fit when the image is made. Cut about {{count}} character.
copy-problem-length: Write both a headline and body text, each up to {{limit}} characters.
copy-problem-first-batch: Your first ads are still being made. Change the copy once they're done.
copy-problem-source-link: Add a source in the product profile
edit-check-clear: The check found nothing to look at.
edit-check-findings: The check found {{count}} things to look at. Redoing fixes them; or say they're fine when you check before downloading.
edit-check-findings_one: The check found 1 thing to look at. Redoing fixes it; or say it's fine when you check before downloading.
edit-uploaded-note: Your own image can't be redone or processed by AI. You can crop or rotate it. If it's under the wrong way of telling, upload it again under the right one.
edit-image-upload-needs-redo: This ad needs redoing, but your own image can't be redone or processed by AI: upload it again under the right way of telling.
edit-ideas-changed: Its claim or copy changed after this image was made, so it can't be redone. Make one with what's there now instead.
edit-note-label: Or say it in your own words
edit-note-placeholder: In English or the ad's language, e.g. Make the car a white SUV.
edit-note-hint: The note goes to the image model as written, so write it in English or the ad's language.
edit-note-findings: Redoing also fixes what the check found. The note is optional; it goes to the image model as written, in English or the ad's language.
edit-again-note: Or make this ad again without changes. The new image is an ad of its own.
edit-image-note: Each change makes a new version; the old one stays. The new version needs checking.
edit-crop-note: Free. Crop first, then rotate clockwise. The new version needs checking.
edit-crop-state-queued: Cropping… You can leave and come back.
edit-crop-state-succeeded: The new version is among the versions. It needs checking.
edit-crop-state-unchanged: The result is the same as this image, so there's no new version.
edit-crop-state-failed: Cropping failed. This image is still as it was.
edit-tools-note: Upscale, remove the background or erase an area with your image provider. You see the maximum cost before anything starts.
edit-tools-review-note: AI processing can change details. The original stays; the new version needs checking.
edit-history-note: Compare a version with the one it was made from. Every version stays an ad of its own: keep the one you want.
edit-telling-note: Tell this claim another way: pick one of the ten types, or describe your own.
edit-technical-note: Redoing uses these image settings. Change them under Image settings on the ad ideas.
add-claim: Think of another claim · up to {{cost}}
add-own-claim-label: Your claim, in your own words
add-own-claim-hint: The AI writes it up from the product's facts and never adds a fact of its own.
add-telling: Another way of telling · up to {{cost}}
add-telling-distinct: Two ways of telling one claim can't be the same type, or a test can't tell them apart.
add-telling-confirm: Add this way of telling · up to {{cost}}
add-started: Started. It appears here when it's ready; its image is a separate step with its own cost.
quote-unavailable-planner_not_configured: This site has not set up the AI model for drafting yet, so nothing can be drafted for now. Ask your administrator.
quote-unavailable-qc_not_configured: This site has not set up the AI model for checking yet, so nothing can be checked for now. Ask your administrator.
add-blocked-first_batch_running: You can add more once the first ads are done.
add-blocked-first_batch_stopped: Making the first ads stopped. Sort that out first, then add more.
add-blocked-planning_in_progress: An idea is still being drafted. Add the next one when it's done.
upload-intro: It goes under one claim and way of telling, and is kept, checked and downloaded like the other ads.
upload-file: Image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB)
upload-file-type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
upload-file-size: This image is larger than 20 MB.
upload-made-by-creator: A creator or a real customer
upload-rights: I have the right to use this image in ads
upload-note: Once placed it can't be moved, redone or processed by AI; you can crop it. Its check usually says the text in the image isn't the ad's copy: if that's fine, say so when you check before downloading.
upload-failed: The upload didn't go through. Try again.
upload-placed: Your image is placed. It's a draft until it's checked.
settings-note: Each version of the ideas uses one set of image settings: images of this version keep the settings it was first made with; new settings apply after the ideas next change (an added claim or way of telling, or checked facts).
settings-unavailable: No image provider is ready to make ads with your own key. Check the keys in Settings.
settings-failed: Couldn't load the image providers. Refresh the page.
guiding-title: Answer {{count}} questions to make the next ideas fit better
guiding-title_one: Answer 1 question to make the next ideas fit better
guiding-intro: Optional. Your answers go with the next claim or way of telling you add.
checks-unavailable-qc_not_configured: Checking isn't set up for this workspace yet. Ask your administrator.
check-redo-unavailable: Redoing needs an image provider that works with your own key. Check the keys in Settings.
photo-declaration: This is a real photo of {{product}}, and I have the right to use it in ads.
photo-declaration-unnamed: This is a real photo of this product, and I have the right to use it in ads.
photo-stale: These ideas changed in the meantime, maybe because someone else checked something. Refresh to see them as they are now, then try again.
photo-not-found: This photo is no longer one of this product's photos. Refresh and look again.
photo-unpublishable: This photo couldn't be saved as a checked photo of the product. Refresh and try again.
photo-uncertain: No answer came back, so it's unclear whether this went through. Trying again repeats the same request; it won't happen twice.
photo-reject-open: Not this product, or can't be used
photo-reject-ads: {{count}} ads were made with it. Once you reject it, they need redoing and can't be downloaded.
photo-reject-ads_one: 1 ad was made with it. Once you reject it, it needs redoing and can't be downloaded.
photo-reject-no-ads: No ad was made with it yet.
photo-reject-in-download: {{count}} of them were in this download and leave it.
photo-reject-in-download_one: 1 of them was in this download and leaves it.
photo-reject-after: Nothing new is made with it. An ad made again uses the photos you can still use.
check-photos-intro: These ads were made with product photos that aren't checked yet. Tick each photo that is a real photo of this product you may use in ads; reject one that isn't.
check-photo-after: Once checked, the ads made with it don't need redoing.
ideas-ad-photo-gone: A product photo it used was rejected or can't be used any more. Use “Edit” to make it again without that photo.
edit-photo-gone: A product photo this ad used was rejected or can't be used any more, so it can't be downloaded. Redo it with a note, or make it once more as it is: the new image uses the photos you can still use, or none if there are none.
ideas-ad-photo-expired: The check of a product photo it used ran out. Renew that photo on the product profile and this ad comes back as it was, with no redoing.
edit-photo-expired: The check of a product photo this ad used ran out, so it can't be downloaded now. Renew that photo on the product profile and this ad comes back as it was: no redoing, nothing to pay.
profile-photos-expiry: A check lasts one year, and each checked photo says until when. After that the photo can't be used and the ads made with it need redoing. Renewing is making the declaration again; once renewed, those ads come back as they were, with no redoing.
profile-photos-plain-intro: Images are made with product photos so the product looks like the real thing.
profile-photos-published-intro: These ads use the product's published photos, which are managed on the product card.
profile-photo-means-unverified: Ads made with it stay drafts until you check it.
profile-photo-means-verified: You confirmed it's a real photo of this product that you may use in ads.
profile-photo-means-rejected: You rejected it. Nothing new is made with it, and the ads made with it need redoing.
profile-photo-means-unavailable: It was checked, but can't be used any more: the check ran out, or the photo was withdrawn or archived in the library. Nothing new is made with it, and the ads made with it need redoing.
profile-photo-add-intro: Use your own photo of the product so the product in the images looks more like it. The photo goes through the upload checks first and is then listed above; until you check it, images made with it are only drafts.
profile-photo-add-adding: Adding it to the product photos…
profile-photo-add-added: Added, not checked yet. Images made with it can be downloaded once you check it.
profile-photo-add-rejected: This image didn't pass the upload checks: {{reason}}
profile-photo-add-rejected-gate: This image didn't pass the upload checks: the file may be damaged, not a picture, too large, or its content not allowed. Try another one.
profile-photo-add-transfer: The photo didn't finish uploading. Try again.
profile-photo-add-timeout: The upload checks haven't finished yet. Try uploading it again in a moment.
profile-photo-add-uncertain: No answer came back, so we don't know whether the photo was added. Refresh to see; if it isn't there, upload it again.
profile-logo-means-unverified: Not checked yet. Once you check it, you can choose it in the brand baseline below.
profile-logo-means-verified: You confirmed it's this brand's logo and that you may use it in ads. You can choose it in the brand baseline below.
profile-logo-means-rejected: You rejected it, so the brand baseline can't use it.
profile-logo-still-in-kit: The saved brand baseline still uses a logo you rejected or that can no longer be used: new images keep carrying it until the Owner changes the brand baseline below and saves it.
profile-logo-means-unavailable: It was checked, but can't be used any more: the check ran out, or it was withdrawn or archived in the library. The brand baseline can't use it.
profile-logo-declaration: This is this brand's logo, and I have the right to use it in ads. Once checked, you can choose it in the brand baseline below.
profile-logo-reject: Not this brand's, or can't be used
profile-logo-reject-question: Once rejected, the brand baseline can't choose it. If a saved brand baseline already uses it, change it there.
profile-logo-add-intro: Upload the brand's logo, ideally a PNG with a transparent or white background. It goes through the upload checks first and is then listed here; once you check it, you can choose it in the brand baseline below. A logo is never used as a product photo.
profile-logo-add-added: Added, not checked yet. Once you check it, you can choose it in the brand baseline.
profile-brand-logo-note: The brand baseline's logo is chosen from the checked logos above; product photos are never used as a logo.
profile-brand-logo-hint: To use a logo, upload it above under “Upload a logo”; once it is checked you can choose it here.
profile-photo-means-unavailable-expired: Its check ran out on {{date}}, so it can't be used now and the ads made with it need redoing. Renew it and those ads come back as they were, with no redoing.
profile-photo-means-unavailable-withdraw: It was withdrawn or archived in the library, so it can't be used or renewed; the ads made with it need redoing.
profile-photo-means-unavailable-file_gon: Its file is no longer there, so it can't be used; the ads made with it need redoing.
profile-photo-renew-intro: The last check ran out on {{date}}. Renewing is making the declaration below again; the new year starts today.
profile-photo-renew-ads: The {{count}} ads made with it come back as they were, with no redoing.
profile-photo-renew-ads_one: The 1 ad made with it comes back as it was, with no redoing.
profile-logo-means-unavailable-expired: Its check ran out on {{date}}, so the brand baseline can't use it; renew it to choose it again.
profile-logo-means-unavailable-withdrawn: It was withdrawn or archived in the library, so it can't be used or renewed.
profile-logo-means-unavailable-file_gone: Its file is no longer there, so it can't be used.
profile-photo-check-again: It is this product: check it
profile-photo-check-ads: {{count}} ads made with it stop waiting for this photo. They don't need redoing.
profile-photo-check-ads_one: 1 ad made with it stops waiting for this photo. It doesn't need redoing.
profile-photo-check-ads-rejected: {{count}} ads made with it no longer need redoing because of this photo.
profile-photo-check-ads-rejected_one: 1 ad made with it no longer needs redoing because of this photo.
claim-form-proposition-hint: One sentence on why it is worth buying.
claim-form-facts-hint: Only facts from the product profile, each with its source. Any number, price or certification in the claim has to be in a fact you pick.
claim-form-facts-none: The product profile has no facts yet.
claim-form-removed: This claim still names {{count}} deleted facts. Saving takes them off.
claim-form-removed_one: This claim still names a deleted fact. Saving takes it off.
claim-form-redo: Once saved, the {{count}} images already made for this claim need making again on the new claim before they can be downloaded.
claim-form-redo_one: Once saved, the image already made for this claim needs making again on the new claim before it can be downloaded.
claim-form-free: Changing a claim is free. The ads keep their headline and body text.
claim-problem-unsupported: These aren't in the facts you picked: {{claims}}. Change them, or add a source in the product profile first.
claim-problem-facts-gone: A fact you picked is no longer in the product profile. Refresh and pick again.
claim-problem-stale: These ideas just changed. Refresh and try again.
claim-problem-uncertain: We didn't hear back. Try again; it won't be changed twice.
claim-delete-ads: The {{count}} images made for it move to “Ads from earlier ideas” at the bottom of the page and can't be downloaded.
claim-delete-ads_one: The image made for it moves to “Ads from earlier ideas” at the bottom of the page and can't be downloaded.
claim-delete-kept: {{count}} of them are kept: they stay kept, and the check before downloading lists them.
claim-delete-kept_one: {{count}} of them is kept: it stays kept, and the check before downloading lists it.
claim-delete-too-few: Keep at least two claims. Change this one instead, or add another claim before deleting it.
profile-audience-note: Until you check it, the product's published details name the market you chose as the audience.
profile-audience-note-checked: A checked audience goes into the product's published details; those are published once you have checked at least one fact or photo. Change the words and it needs checking again.
profile-audience-form-note: Once saved, it needs checking again.
profile-unsourced-intro: The AI read these, but the material has no source for them, so no claim or ad uses them. Add a source and one becomes a fact, still for you to check.
reading-unsourced: “{{claim}}” has no source, so no ad will use it.
